title: Easy joining: join codes, UPnP port opening, copy code, firewall fix
body: Requested: make LAN games easy to join without opening ports. Net.join_code / parse_join_code (IPv4+port, Crockford base32, typo tolerant); Join box accepts a code. Hosts run UPnP discovery in a thread, map UDP port and port+1, read the public IP (CGNAT detected), remove the mappings on leave; status lines explain the result. Pause menu COPY JOIN CODE; Host screen UPnP checkbox and FIX FIREWALL (Windows, elevated netsh rule). tools/join_code_test.gd in gate F.

title: Relay server so internet games work without UPnP or port forwarding
body: UPnP covers most home routers but not CGNAT, mobile hotspots or routers with UPnP off. A small relay (or Steam networking / a hosted dedicated server) would make internet play zero-setup for everyone.
